spots.name: River bridge
spots.notes: Watch from the Butler Trail / Lamar Beach side of Lady Bird Lake, well back from the tracks; Amtrak crosses here twice a day; restrooms and shade along the trail. (verify parking on the day)

spots.name: Pressler St
spots.notes: Gated grade crossing with sidewalks, two blocks from the Amtrak station; horns sound here (not a quiet zone). (verify a place to stand back)

spots.name: Dittmar Rd
spots.notes: Gated grade crossing, trains up to 60 mph, quiet zone (no horns); the most-filmed south Austin spot. (verify sidewalk and parking)
